data.title: Lisk: Chain Shutdown Requires Holders to Bridge Funds to Ethereum - 31 Oct 2026
data.description: Lisk has confirmed that Lisk Chain shuts down, and users must bridge their funds to Ethereum before closure. Withdrawal takes about 8 days, with unstaking adding a 3-day waiting period, so a complete move can span roughly 11 days. The deadline applies to all LSK holders on the chain.This is a force…
